instructions: /project may have two git remotes: 'origin' (target — where pushes go) and 'bootstrap' (read-only template source).
Always commit on a feature branch named 'lingua/<short-topic>'. Never commit directly to main or master.
Push to 'origin' only when the user explicitly asks. Never push to 'bootstrap' (its push URL is intentionally disabled).
To pull template upgrades from the bootstrap repo: git fetch bootstrap && git merge bootstrap/main.
